tagline: Receive from Apple on a compatible bridge and forward to Windows or Linux
idle: Ready — start a receiver or choose a file to send
receive_help: On the destination computer, start the receiver and copy its invitation to the computer that will send the file
network_help: Choose this computer's local IPv4 address and an available port — both computers must be able to communicate on that network
invitation_help: The invitation permits transfer requests in this session — share it only with your chosen bridge and confirm each incoming file
send_help: Paste the destination invitation, select a file and send — the recipient has 90 seconds to accept
transfer_help: Local transfer with TLS and SHA-256 verification — received files are saved in individual folders and never opened or executed automatically
bridge_help:
macOS: accept AirDrop on your Mac, then select the received file
Linux: configure OWL and OpenDrop on compatible hardware to experiment with AirDrop reception
Then select the file and use Send to forward it to the destination
inbox_help: The queue scans up to 2,000 entries in a dedicated folder after 3 seconds without changes — confirm that reception has finished before sending
restart_language: Your selected language will apply when you reopen ChimpiShare
stop_to_change: Stop the corresponding receiver before changing its folder
listening: Receiver active at {host}:{port} — waiting for requests
stopped: Receiver stopped — the previous invitation has expired
waiting_approval: Preparing file and waiting for destination approval…
sending: Sending {amount} of {total} — waiting for confirmation when complete
airdrop_confirm:
Start OpenDrop for this experimental session?

OpenDrop automatically accepts nearby incoming files into the bridge folder
Forwarding to the destination remains manual
OWL must be configured and its radio must be separate from the local network connection

Compatibility with your Apple device still needs to be tested
airdrop_exited: OpenDrop exited with code {code} — check the external OpenDrop/OWL configuration
invalid_invitation: Invalid invitation — copy the complete invitation from the receiver
invalid_request: Invalid request — check the IPv4 address, port and file information
invalid_response: The destination returned an incompatible response
unauthorized: The invitation does not belong to this session — copy a new invitation
too_large: The file exceeds the receiver's configured limit
disk_full: There is not enough space at the destination
busy: The receiver is already handling another request — try again later
denied: The recipient declined or did not confirm in time
expired: Transfer authorization expired — request the transfer again
checksum_mismatch: The content does not match its SHA-256 — no file was published
storage_error: The destination could not write the file
certificate_mismatch: The destination certificate does not match the invitation — the connection was closed before sending
regular_files_only: Choose a regular file — symbolic links and folders are not sent
file_changed: The file changed during transfer — wait for writing to finish and try again
linux_only: Experimental OWL reception requires Linux with direct Wi-Fi access — on macOS, accept using native AirDrop and select the received file
awdl_missing: OpenDrop and the awdl0 interface are unavailable — configure the Linux bridge using docs/LINUX-AWDL.md
cli_host: Local IPv4 address to bind the receiver to
cli_invite_file: Private file containing the receiver invitation
